title: Fake sites in search in practice
intro: The first result is not always right. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: tapan.example
decisions.prompt: At the top is an ad, and below it is the app's own site. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: You skipped the ad and opened the app's own site.

decisions.title: tapan.example
decisions.prompt: The first search result is an ad. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: You skipped the ad and chose the result whose address ends in gov.az.

decisions.title: gorus-app-download.example.net
decisions.prompt: The page looks a lot like the real site. Look at the address. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: The address was not the app's own site. Go to the official site yourself.

decisions.title: vetendasportal.gov.az-arayis.example
decisions.prompt: On a phone only the start of the address shows. Read it to the end. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: The real owner of a site is at the end of the address, and this one did not end in gov.az.

decisions.title: GorusSetup_2026.exe
decisions.prompt: The file has downloaded. Will you open it?
decisions.explain: Delete the file, tell technical support, and get the app from the official site.
